name: g1_hands_regression
_note: W2/D4 regression gate. The locomotion acceptance protocol of experiments/g1_locomotion.py (same functions, seeds and profiles as experiments/configs/g1_locomotion.json) is rerun on the 43-actuator G1 (Dex3 finger hinges added by MjSpec) with fingers held open and with fingers cycling through their full range while the robot walks, and compared with the unchanged 29-actuator model on identical seeds. Gates written before the first run. 'Spread' is the min..max over the seeds of the 29-actuator run.

gates._rule: Against no_hands on the same seeds. tracking: per profile, the median over seeds of the commanded-axis speed (forward, lateral or yaw) lies inside the no_hands per-seed min..max. drift: median standing drift inside the no_hands min..max and max <= locomotion.gates.standing_drift_m_max. push: recovered count per force >= no_hands count. goto: success >= locomotion.gates.goto_success_min and median true error inside the no_hands min..max.
